name: @amodalai/example-underwriting-review
description: An Amodal example that triages commercial insurance submissions against an underwriting guide: two triggered tools, a reviewer subagent, five stores, a custom React UI with a screen for the underwriter and a screen for the broker, and preToolUse hooks that restrict model-selected writes and check required documents.

scripts.test: tsx --no-cache --tsconfig tsconfig.app.json --test src/*.test.tsx src/components/*.test.tsx amodal/_lib/*.test.ts hooks/*/*.test.mjs

amodal.name: underwriting-review-example
amodal.description: Triage commercial property submissions against a fictional underwriting guide. The underwriting-reviewer subagent scores each submission and recommends a workflow status for a human underwriter. The agent assists; a human decides.
